name: awesome-mpc
desc: A curated list of multi party computation resources and links.

resources.name: A Pragmatic Introduction to Secure Multi-Party Computation
resources.desc: A broad introduction to the field of secure multi-party computation, covering both the fundamental constructions and many of the recent improvements. The book emphasizes the intuition and ideas behind the protocols rather than rigorous proofs.

resources.name: Applications of Secure Multiparty Computation
resources.desc: Collection of MPC protocols for several real-world tasks such as statistics.

resources.name: Efficient Secure Two-Party Protocols
resources.desc: Comprehensive study of efficient protocols and techniques for secure two-party computation – both general constructions that can be used to securely compute any functionality, and protocols for specific problems of interest.

resources.name: Secure Multiparty Computation and Secret Sharing
resources.desc: Comprehensive treatment of unconditionally secure techniques for multiparty computation (MPC) and secret sharing.

resources.name: Cryptographic Computing Course
resources.desc: Course on MPC, Homomorphic Encryption and related topics given by Claudio Orlandi at Aarhus University.

resources.name: FHE-MPC Advanced Grad Course
resources.desc: 'Informal grad course' in FHE and MPC.

resources.name: Secure Computation
resources.desc: Secure Computation course offered by Indian Institute of Science covering secret sharing schemes, oblivious transfer to impossibility results and zero-knowledge proofs.

resources.name: Secure Multi-Party Computation at Scale
resources.desc: Boston University course that covers mathematical and algorithmic foundations of MPC, with an additional focus on deployment of state-of-the-art MPC technologies.

resources.name: Getting Started with MPC
resources.desc: Light compilation of basic resources for getting started in MPC study and research.

resources.name: How To Simulate It
resources.desc: A Tutorial on the Simulation Proof Technique.

resources.name: OSU Bibliography
resources.desc: An Annotated Bibliography of Practical Secure Computation.

resources.name: TinySMPC (tutorial)
resources.desc: A tiny, educational, Pythonic library for SMPC. The tutorial notebook runs in your browser.

resources.name: UC Security
resources.desc: Video lectures on UC security delivered by Ran Canetti.

resources.name: ePrint papers
resources.desc: Frequently updated list of secure computation papers appearing on IACR eprint.

resources.name: MPC deployments
resources.desc: A hub for real-world MPC deployments maintained by UC

resources.name: 2PC is for Lovers
resources.desc: Allows two people to find out if they are secretly in love with each other using malicious secure 2PC of a single AND gate.

resources.name: MPC Hello
resources.desc: Malicious secure 2PC calculating the larger of two numbers. Also a template repository for building malicious secure 2PC web apps for any circuit.

resources.name: TLS Notary
resources.desc: Uses MPC to blindly sign TLS data, allowing users to make proofs about the content of data served to them over https.

resources.name: ABY3
resources.desc: 3PC with secret sharing for privacy preserving machine learning and database joins (PSI, Union, etc.); secure against semi-honest adversaries. | CCS'18, 2019/518.

resources.name: Carbyne Stack
resources.desc: MPC cloud platform that combines state-of-the-art MPC with cloud-native technology like Kubernetes, Istio, and Knative to enable MPC deployments at scale.

resources.name: EMP-toolkit
resources.desc: 2PC and MPC with garbled circuits; secure against semi-honest adversaries (emp-sh2pc). There are also ones resistant against malicious parties (emp-[ag2pc|m2pc|agmpc]) | eprint: 2017/189, 2016/762, 2017/030.

resources.name: FRESCO
resources.desc: MPC supporting TinyTables or SPDZ protocols; secure against semi-honest or malicious adversaries. | Practice'15.

resources.name: HPMPC
resources.desc: HPMPC implements multiple MPC protocols and provides a high-level C++ interface to define functions and use cases. Out of the box, the framework supports computation in the boolean and arithmetic domain, mixed circuits, and fixed point arithmetic. Neural network models can be imported from PyTorch as part of PIGEON.

resources.name: JIFF
resources.desc: JavaScript client and server libraries for building web-based applications that employ general purpose MPC; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | documentation: link.

resources.name: MP-SPDZ
resources.desc: MPC with garbled circuits or secret sharing; secure against malicious or semi-honest adversaries with dishonest or honest majority. | documentation | eprint: 2020/512

resources.name: MPC
resources.desc: Go-based secure two-party computation framework combining a garbled-circuit runtime, the MPCL compiler, circuit tooling, OT primitives, and a WIP BMR implementation.

resources.name: MPC Framework
resources.desc: TypeScript framework for doing MPC with multiple techniques for generating circuits and MPC backends. In particular, it supports summon circuits and emp-wasm-backend for malicious secure 2PC.

resources.name: MPZ
resources.desc: A collection of multi-party computation libraries written in Rust 🦀. Strives to provide safe, performant, modular and portable MPC software with a focus on usability.

resources.name: MPyC
resources.desc: BGW honest majority multi-party protocol; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | TPMPC'18.

resources.name: ORQ
resources.desc: General framework for relational analytics written in C++; includes fast sorting implementations and supports multiple protocols. | SOSP'25

resources.name: SecretFlow-SPU
resources.desc: A domain-specific compiler and runtime suite, that aims to provide a secure computation service with provable security. SPU compiler uses XLA as its front-end Intermediate Representation (IR) and SPU runtime implements various MPC protocols. | USENIX ATC'23.

resources.name: Sharemind
resources.desc: 2PC or 3PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | Cyber'13.

resources.name: swanky
resources.desc: A suite of rust libraries for secure multi-party computation (currently includes oblivious transfer, garbled circuits, and private set intersection).

resources.name: Stoffel
resources.desc: A framework for robust MPC protocols which includes a custom compiler, VM runtime, SDKs targeted at developers with minimal MPC knowledge.

resources.name: TNO-MPC
resources.desc: Collection of MPC generic software components, procedures, functionalities, and solutions based on secret sharing and (partially) homomorphic encryption developed in Python and Go. | Blogs and principles: TNO MPC Lab.

resources.name: Velox
resources.desc: Post-Quantum asynchronous MPC implemented in Rust. Offers Fairness against $t<\frac{n}{3}$ malicious parties. Scales to $n=100$ parties in a geo-distributed network. | eprint: 2025/1630.

resources.name: Zama KMS
resources.desc: Zama's MPC-based key management system for threshold key generation and threshold decryption for FHE. | WAHC'23, Spec

resources.name: aes-prng
resources.desc: Rust pseudo-random number generator based on AES.

resources.name: APRICOT
resources.desc: OT Extension secure against malicious adversaries. | 2015/546.

resources.name: Distributed Vector-OLE
resources.desc: A two-party generator for Vector-OLE correlations. CCS'19.

resources.name: LibOTe
resources.desc: Library with various OT Extensions.

resources.name: OT Extension
resources.desc: OT Extension secure against malicious adversaries. | 2015/061.

resources.name: SCAPI
resources.desc: Various secure computation API's carefully documented with a clean code design in mind. | 2012/629.

resources.name: SplitCommit
resources.desc: Additively homomorphic commitment scheme. | 2015/694.

resources.name: TSS
resources.desc: A pure-Rust implementation of various threshold secret sharing schemes.

resources.name: BaRK-OPRF
resources.desc: Private Set Intersection. | 2016/799.

resources.name: Blockchain-Crypto-MPC
resources.desc: Multiparty ECDSA signing in the cryptocurrency setting, includes an optimized GC library, OT, and more. | CCS'18.

resources.name: Fireblocks MPC
resources.desc: Multiparty ECDSA and EdDSA | eprint 2020/492.

resources.name: LibPSI
resources.desc: Various protocols for performing private set intersection.

resources.name: Linreg
resources.desc: Privacy preserving linear regression. | 2016/892.

resources.name: Geppetri
resources.desc: Verifiable 3PC. | 2017/013.

resources.name: MPECDSA
resources.desc: Threshold multiparty ECDSA from ECDSA assumptions. | S&P'19.

resources.name: ORAM (Obliv-C)
resources.desc: Oblivious RAM. | S&P'16.

resources.name: Prio
resources.desc: Private aggregation with SNIPs (secret-shared non-interactive proofs). | NSDI'17.

resources.name: PSI
resources.desc: Private Set Intersection. | 2014/447.

resources.name: ROOM
resources.desc: Read-Only Oblivious Maps and applications to secure machine learning on sparse data. | CCS'19.

resources.name: CBMC-GC
resources.desc: Creates Boolean circuits from ANSI-C code optimized for secure computation. | ShallowCC.

resources.name: CipherCompute
resources.desc: Create generic MPC programs using Rust. Works on top of the SCALE engine. Enterprise software that provides UIs for participants handshaking, computations approval, datasources connections, auditing etc...

resources.name: Circom 2 Arithc
resources.desc: Compiles bristol circuits for MPC from circom code.

resources.name: Conclave
resources.desc: Big Data query compiler that combines cleartext processing with Spark and MPC protocols. | EuroSys19.

resources.name: Garble-Lang
resources.desc: Programming language for MPC with Garbled Circuits. Garble is statically typed, low-level, purely functional and uses a syntax heavily inspired by Rust.

resources.name: HyCC
resources.desc: Optimizes circuits for hybrid MPC from ANSI-C. | CCS'18.

resources.name: MPC-SoK
resources.desc: Build environments for many MPC frameworks using Docker containers. | S&P19.

resources.name: Private Benchmarking
resources.desc: Provides an End to End platform to perform Private Benchmarking using MPC and GPU-based Confidential Computing on LLMs/CNNs/Vision Models using EzPC framework. | eprint.

resources.name: Summon
resources.desc: A TypeScript-like language for compiling bristol circuits for MPC. Also available as an npm module.

resources.name: Tiny-Garble
resources.desc: Logic Synthesis and Sequential Descriptions for Yao's Garbled Circuits. | S&P'15.

resources.name: UC Compiler
resources.desc: Valiant's Universal Circuit Compiler. | 2016/093.

resources.name: ABY
resources.desc: 2PC with secret sharing and garbled circuits; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | NDSS'15.

resources.name: BatchDualEx
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits; secure against malicious adversaries. | eprint: 2016/632.

resources.name: CrypTen
resources.desc: MPC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversary; focused on building PyTorch applications. | documentation: link

resources.name: Duplo
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits; secure against malicious adversaries.

resources.name: EzPC
resources.desc: Offers a suite of tools for secure machine learning using semi-honest MPC protocols. It includes a language for secure machine learning, compilers for TensorFlow/Onnx to various MPC protocols, and frameworks for training and inference on deep neural networks. It provides an end-to-end solution for secure machine learning. | documentation: link. End-to-End Platform: link

resources.name: Fancy-Garbling
resources.desc: 2PC with arithmetic garbled circuits; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | eprint: 2016/969.

resources.name: FairPlayMP
resources.desc: GMW based multi-party protocol secure against semi-honest adversaries | CCS'08.

resources.name: Frigate
resources.desc: C-style compiler for optimizing boolean circuits. | Euro S&P'16.

resources.name: HoneyBadgerMPC
resources.desc: Robust MPC-based confidentiality layer for blockchains with guaranteed output delivery; secure against up to t < n/3 malicious parties.

resources.name: libTMCG
resources.desc: C++ framework with various primitives and tools for implementing multiparty games; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | documentation: link

resources.name: Moose
resources.desc: 3PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries; focused on data processing and machine learning.

resources.name: MOTION
resources.desc: Mixed-Protocol MPC framework supporting full-threshold boolean and arithmetic GMW and BMR; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | eprint: 2020/1137.

resources.name: Myst
resources.desc: Secure Multiparty Key Generation, Signature and Decryption JavaCard applet and host application | CCS'17.

resources.name: Obliv-C
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | eprint: 2015/1153.

resources.name: Obliv-Java
resources.desc: Faithful reimplementation of Java using Obliv-C. | eprint: 2017/878

resources.name: Rosetta
resources.desc: 3PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries; focused on reusing the APIs of TensorFlow and allowing to transfer traditional TensorFlow codes into a privacy-preserving manner with minimal changes.

resources.name: SCALE-MAMBA
resources.desc: General MPC with secret sharing; secure against various adversaries including malicious with a dishonest majority. Software closer to a production system. | documentation: link.

resources.name: SDA
resources.desc: Secure distributed aggregation of high-dimensional vectors | 2017/643.

resources.name: SPDZ
resources.desc: General MPC with secret sharing; secure against malicious adversaries | eprint: 2017/1230.

resources.name: SPDZ-Yao
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits; high-level language similar to SPDZ; secure against semi-honest adversaries.

resources.name: Semi-honest BMR
resources.desc: BMR protocol secure against semi-honest adversaries | 2016/1066.

resources.name: Tandem
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits written in Rust; secure against malicious adversaries.

resources.name: Tasty
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits and homomorphic encryption | 2010/365.

resources.name: TF Encrypted
resources.desc: 3PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries; focused on TensorFlow-based applications.

resources.name: TinyLEGO
resources.desc: 2PC with garbled circuits; secure against malicious adversaries | eprint: 2015/309.

resources.name: VIFF
resources.desc: 3+PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries | PhD Dissertation.

resources.name: Wysteria
resources.desc: Multiparty computation with GMW, written in a functional PL; secure against semi-honest adversaries | S&P'14.

resources.name: IIT Bombay MPC school
resources.desc: Covers basic and advanced topics related to the theory of MPC aimed at CS students and researchers interested in cryptography.

resources.name: RWMPC
resources.desc: Real World MPC (RWMPC) Workshop. Started in 2025 and is co-located with the Real World Crypto (RWC) conference.

resources.name: Securing Computation
resources.desc: Conducted at Simons institute for Theory of Computing.

resources.name: The 1st BIU Winter School
resources.desc: Introductory lectures for basic secure computation constructions.

resources.name: The 5th BIU Winter School
resources.desc: Tutorials and recent advances in secure computation delivered in video format.

resources.name: TPMPC
resources.desc: Yearly workshop on theory and practice of MPC that started in Aarhus 2012. It has now become one of the biggest workshops for MPC people.
